target.name: Hosting services and data center costs
target.quote: Cost of subscription revenue increased during the three and nine months ended August 28, 2026 as compared to the three and nine months ended August 29, 2025 primarily due to the following: Components of % Change 2026-2025 QTD Components of % Change 2026-2025 YTD Hosting services and data center costs 22 % 17 %

input.note: The claim refers to Q3 FY2026 (ended August 28, 2026). Evidence E3 provides the bridge for cost of subscription revenue changes, showing hosting services and data center costs contributed 22% of the 24% total change in the quarter. Evidence E6 provides the actual dollar amounts for cost of subscription revenue ($633M in Q3 2026 vs $510M in Q3 2025). The other components are compensation costs (5%), amortization of intangibles (-5%), and various individually insignificant items (2%).
